what: A bassline after the Erica Synths DB-01, with only what the DB-01 has: one VCO with sub and noise, BBD detune, overdrive, a Polivoks-style LP/BP filter, a drone-capable VCA, an LFO with 10 shapes, and its 64-step sequencer with accent, slide, mod track, pitch envelope and probability per step, play modes, random patterns, scales and an arpeggiator.
author: swtdr34mz
